title: Business Calendar
description: Immutable seller working-time calendar, declared before use. A changed schedule, timezone, closure list, or coverage requires a new calendar_id. Retain declarations while requests using them are pending. Non-working dates are complete over the inclusive coverage dates. Sellers MUST NOT offer a business commitment whose deadline falls beyond this coverage.

business_day_minutes.description: Working minutes represented by P1D. P1DT4H consumes this many minutes plus four working hours, even with unequal daily schedules.

working_periods.description: Non-overlapping half-open local-time periods. start_time MUST precede end_time. Split overnight periods at midnight; 24:00 is accepted only as an end. On DST transitions nonexistent local boundaries advance to the first existing instant; ambiguous starts use the earlier instant and ambiguous ends the later instant. Count actual elapsed seconds within the resulting union of working intervals.

non_working_dates.description: Complete list of local non-working dates within coverage, overriding weekly periods. An empty list explicitly means no additional closures in that interval.

verifier_constraints.calendar_integrity: valid_from <= valid_through; working periods have start < end and never overlap on a shared weekday; all non_working_dates are within coverage; timezone resolves in IANA TZDB; calendar_id is immutable and unique within the seller.
